content.title: No Kings
content.text: In America, we have No Kings.Masked secret police terrorizing our communities. An illegal, catastrophic war putting us in danger and driving up our costs. Attacks on our freedom of speech, our civil rights, our freedom to vote. Costs pushing families to the brink. Trump wants to rule over us as a tyrant. But this is America, and power belongs to the people - not to wannabe kings or their billionaire cronies. On March 28th, we show up together, and we say, loud and clear: No Kings. Find an Event near youAs President Trump escalates his attempts to control us, it is on us, the people, to show that we will fight to protect one another and our country. If he believes we will roll over and allow him to take our freedoms, he is mistaken. We are coming together again on March 28 because we know we can overcome this repression when we unite. Upcoming Trainings Wednesday, March 25 at 8:00PM ESTLearn how to talk to your friends, family and community about No Kings. Share with confidence why they should join you at your local event, why it matters to take action together now, and the vision for America that we’re fighting for together. In this training you’ll workshop how to talk to your people with leading communications experts from No Kings. jueves, 26 de marzo at 7:00PM EDTAprende cómo hablar con tus amistades, tu familia y tu comunidad sobre No Kings, para que te sientas seguro/a de compartir el por qué deberían acompañarte en tu evento local, por qué es importante actuar juntos ahora y cuál es la visión de país por la que estamos luchando. En esta capacitación trabajarás en cómo hablar con tu gente junto a expertos en comunicación que forman parte del movimiento No Kings. Thursday, March 26 at 8:00PM EDTIt’s almost No Kings 3! Join this final preparation call for hosts to ensure that you have large, safe, and powerful events on Saturday. During this call, we will also talk about how to deepen our movement, starting with “What's Next” Organizing Meetings. Friday, April 3 at 3:00PM ESTAs hosts, you have power the fight for America. On the Friday after No Kings, over 3,000 hosts will gather together to digest and debrief the historic No Kings activations and plan how to deepen our movement, starting with “What's Next” Organizing Meetings. The Work Continues America has a long history, rooted in white supremacy, of suppressing the rights of people of color. But our history also clearly shows that people-powered movements are how we end authoritarianism.Throughout 2025, in the face of unprecedented attacks, millions of us joined together in our communities and held the largest single day of morally grounded, nonviolent direct actions by any movement in US history. Each time we show up, we disrupt President Trump’s attempts to rule through repression and remind the country, and the world, that people power is our path to a truly free America.
